08-02-1483 is February 8, 1483.  
49 weeks + 7 days = 49*7 + 7 = 343 + 7 = 350 days.  
Add 350 days to 1483-02-08:  
1483 is not a leap year (1483 mod 4 = 3), so Feb has 28 days.  
From Feb 8: 350 - (28 - 8) = 350 - 20 = 330 days left, now at Mar 1.  
March 31, April 30, May 31, June 30, July 31, August 31, September 30, October 31, November 30, December 31.  
Days used by end of Dec: 330 - (31+30+31+30+31+31+30+31+30+31) = 330 - 306 = 24 days left into next year.  
New year 1484 (leap year? 1484 mod 4 = 0, yes, leap).  
24 days into 1484: January 24.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1484-01-24
